about:
I'm **Yash Kumar Singh**, a B.Tech student at **Delhi Technological University (DTU)** with a focus on **backend architectures**, **systems programming**, and **algorithmic problem solving**.

I build performant systems from the ground up — including a **custom C++ Mini Redis server** with an O(1) LRU cache and raw TCP sockets, and a **production-ready Backend Banking Ledger** with transactional integrity. As **Team Manager – Avionics & Software** at **Rocketry DTU**, I lead flight computers, telemetry protocols, and ground-station development, having won an **"Excellent" Grade at the IN-SPACe & ISRO Rocketry Competition (2025)**.

With an **1850+ LeetCode rating (Knight Badge)** and over **800+ DSA problems solved**, I thrive on computational performance and writing robust, scalable code. I am eager to apply my skills to challenging software engineering and systems roles.
